scope: Independent Three.js / three-mesh-bvh comparison against the complete original PLY triangle topology. The original scan is an exchange reference, not physical ground truth.

predeclaredAcceptance.method: No arbitrary distance thresholds. Compare full-cloud distance distributions in source coordinate units with the source incident-edge spacing and edge-length distributions, measured before reconstruction. Topological defects and incomplete self-intersection analysis are reported explicitly.

limitations: Distances are exact point-to-triangle queries at every source vertex, output vertex, and output face centroid; these finite sample sets are not a continuous symmetric Hausdorff certificate.
Source coordinate units are preserved and are not independently certified as millimetres.
Vertex-link manifold classification follows retained indices; coincident unmerged vertices are separately reported.
The original scan may contain holes, noise and normal defects. Agreement with it does not establish physical accuracy.
